title: Core actions are hidden without the shared core permission
custom_preconds:
1. A test customer exists. If not: Customers -> New Customer, enter a name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and save.
  2. A test vendor exists to order parts from. If not: Parts -> Vendors -> New Vendor, enter a Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Parts Supply"), then Save & Close.
  3. Start a new part sale today (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way): Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, then select the customer.
  4. On the Parts tab click Add Part and fill the row: Description "Water Pump", Quantity 1, Vendor = the test vendor, Sell Price $517.55, and in the Core column a Core Charge of $79.99. Save the row.
  5. In that row's Actions column click Order and confirm. The row now shows Awaiting.
  6. Click Receive on the row; in the Receive parts dialog keep the full quantity and confirm. The part row reads Received and its core row offers Return Core in the Actions column.
  7. A service work order for the same customer with a received core: Work Orders -> New Work Order, select the customer, add a line, add a part to it with Vendor = the test vendor and a Core Charge of $79.99, then Order and Receive the part.
  8. Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Parts Manager") -> Apply; tick Part sales -> Create & Edit, and untick Vendors -> Create & Edit, Work Order Parts -> Create and Work Orders -> Create & Edit; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST Parts no core" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open a spare test user -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST Parts no core" -> save. That user must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session). This user is User X.
  9. Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Parts Manager") -> Apply; untick See Financial Data; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST No financial data" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open a spare test user -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST No financial data" -> save. That user must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session). This user is User Y.
  10. Build the sale and the work order while signed in as an Owner/Admin user, then switch to User X and User Y for the steps.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as User X, open the part sale, and on the received core row look for Return Core and Cancel Return.
  2. Confirm User X can still see the core row and its charge.
  3. Still as User X, open the service work order and on its received core row look for Return Core and Cancel Return.
  4. Sign in as User Y and try to open the part sale's Parts grid.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On the part sale, User X sees the core row and its charge but is offered neither Return Core nor Cancel Return.
  • On the service work order, User X is likewise offered neither Return Core nor Cancel Return.
  • User Y (no See Financial Data) cannot reach the part sale parts grid at all and never sees a core row; this project does not open part sales to those users.
  • Not checkable by hand: if User X sends Return Core or Cancel Return by any route other than the screens, the system refuses it. A manual tester has no way to send an action outside the screens, so this part is left to automation.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10262 (Story 1, Return a core on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 1; design canvas boards Cores_*/Document_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N2: “A user who holds none of the permissions above sees the core row and its charge, but is offered neither Return Core nor Cancel Return, on a part sale or a work order. If that user sends either action by any other route, the system refuses it”
  • S1-N5: “See Financial Data gates the whole part sale screen, so a user without it never reaches the parts grid and never sees a core row. This project does not open part sales to those users”
